question: In Box: Add the tag harbor-final to the favorited copy of Harbor launch plan.pdf in the Harbor Launch folder that also has the Harbor budget spreadsheet.
final:
Done. I disambiguated first, since there were two "Harbor Launch" folders and multiple copies of the PDF:

- **Folder** (id 8100): contains "Harbor launch plan.pdf" + **Harbor budget.xlsx** (the spreadsheet) → this one
- The other folder (8101) has a Harbor budget.pdf, so it didn't match

The favorited copy in that folder is file **8110** — "Harbor launch plan.pdf" (the only one in both that folder and your Favorites). It had no tags, so I set its tags to `["harbor-final"]` and verified it took.
